newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Minproc plans action on Yolanda costs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Minproc plans action on Yolanda costs.

text.p: Miner and mining contractor Minproc Engineers Ltd said on Thursday it plans to take legal action to recover more than US$9.5 million from Minera Yolanda S.A., a subsidiary of Canada's Kap Resources Ltd.
The action follows a breakdown in talks to address a cost increase for engineering construction work at the Yolanda Nitrates project in Chile, Minproc said in a statement.
"It is intended to suspend the project works effective close of business on January 22, 1997, if a satisfactory resolution of the current matters is not achieved prior to that date," it said.
Minproc announced last August it had taken on the role of principal contractor at Yolanda from its former U.S. affiliate Mincorp Ltd.
The company said on Thursday a subsequent re-estimate of the forecast final cost for Yolanda added US$6.25 million to the previous forecast cost.

"Negotiations to address this cost increase with Minera Yolanda S.A. have been ongoing, but have now reached a point where the parties are unable to reach mutually acceptable amendments to the principal terms and conditions to the contract," it said.
Minproc said legal advice had confirmed that the maximum liability under the contracts was limited to US$4.652 million.
